scope: 单用户、本地优先、无真实资金、无自动实盘的 Paper V1

proves: 候选 commit、tree、文件 mode/type/blob 与内容哈希可核对
审查与执行证据不能静默跨候选复用
does_not_prove: 文件中的主体、命令或结果字段真实
Git author 或 committer 字段对应真实身份
作者与审查者组织独立

proves: 通过精确 policy 验证后，GitHub 签发的 attestation 把指定 artifact digest 绑定到预期 repository、workflow 与 source commit
本地验证器可独立解析被绑定 manifest 的固定检查、攻击结果与内容哈希
does_not_prove: workflow 可控制的 predicate 字段均为真实陈述
manifest 声称的命令与结果仅因 attestation 而真实
测试 oracle 或设计语义正确
GitHub 平台、仓库 owner 与所有构造主体不串谋

proves: 候选固定后存在可由用户在 Codex App 检查的单独子代理审查线程
审查输入、输出、候选与新增 novelty probe 的内容绑定可在仓库中核对
does_not_prove: 子代理线程构成安全意义上的上下文隔离
审查者人类身份的密码学证明
仓库内 locator 字符串本身不可伪造

github_actions_machine_execution.workflow_ref_policy: exact workflow path on the exact candidate commit
local_verification_policy: verify artifact digest with GitHub attestation verification
require the expected OIDC issuer, signer repository, exact workflow identity, source commit and predicate type
reject an unexpected source ref, signer workflow, issuer, source digest or self-hosted runner identity
parse the manifest and independently validate every required check and attack result
do not treat attestation as semantic approval

required_binding: candidate-postdated novelty probe spec and actual runner receipt
codex_semantic_review.user_check: Javen can open the named subagent thread in Codex App and compare its prompt/result with the stored hashes.

required: local frozen runner replay passes against the exact reviewed candidate
GitHub-issued workflow provenance for the assurance manifest is observed and verifies against exact repository/workflow/source commit and policy
post-candidate Codex semantic review covers the full ground-truth manifest
at least one post-candidate novelty probe is actually executed and rejected
no open critical, major, or minor final-review finding remains

machine_receipt_invariants: runner process exit must equal receipt.runner_exit_code
unmutated candidate verifier exit must be zero
mutated target verifier exit must be nonzero
the expected invariant-specific rejection signal must occur in actual target stdout
arbitrary command strings are descriptive only and never authorize execution
runner bytes must match the exact reviewed candidate
stored receipts are re-executed; internal hash consistency alone is insufficient

covered: 构造者手写 command、stdout、exit code 或自洽哈希冒充实际攻击结果
构造者用自己预先知道的 canonical tests 冒充 reviewer novelty
旧候选的机器或语义证据复用于新候选
只审衍生摘要而漏掉原始意图、决定、方法、研究主体或验证实现
单一 builder verdict 或单一脚本退出码批准完成
not_covered: 同一 OS 管理员或恶意软件重写全部本地状态
仓库 owner、GitHub、OpenAI 平台、主代理和全部子代理共同串谋
组织级独立审计或受监管职责分离
审查者人类身份的密码学证明
真实资金系统所需的券商、密钥、权限和合规边界

upgrade_triggers.trigger: 任何真实资金、live broker 或自动订单执行
upgrade_triggers.required_upgrade: 独立身份、受保护分支/ruleset、外部 functionary 签名、密钥与交易权限隔离及适用合规审查

upgrade_triggers.trigger: 多人使用、对外服务或商业发布
upgrade_triggers.required_upgrade: 多租户身份权限、隐私安全、组织级审查与责任边界

upgrade_triggers.trigger: GitHub 或 Codex 平台能力/证明格式变化
upgrade_triggers.required_upgrade: 重新验证 trust root，不沿用旧观察
